# Trivio — Nashik Travel Guide

> Trivio is an Android travel guide focused on Nashik, Maharashtra, India. The website introduces the app, highlights selected destinations around Nashik, and explains its trip-planning features.

- Website: https://nashik.sooubh.me/
- Android app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sooubh.nashikexplore
- Support: trivio-support@sooubh.in
- Primary location: Nashik, Maharashtra, India
- Primary language: English (with English, Hindi and Marathi destination names where available)

## What Trivio helps visitors do

- Discover places around Nashik across temples, heritage, forts and treks, vineyards, and nature.
- Search and filter available destination listings.
- Read place descriptions, view photos, and check practical details where those fields are available.
- Plan a multi-day visit using preferences such as trip duration, budget, travel style, interests, transport and pace.
- Request AI-assisted itinerary suggestions through the app, with a local rule-based fallback when the remote generator is unavailable.
- Save places to wishlist boards when signed in.
- Open available destination map links in an external maps application.

Generated itineraries are suggestions, not live route guarantees. Venue hours, entry fees, access rules, road conditions and seasonal conditions can change; visitors should confirm current details with the relevant venue or local authority.

## Selected Nashik-area destinations

- Trimbakeshwar Shiva Temple — heritage and pilgrimage.
- Shree Kalaram Mandir and Panchavati — heritage and cultural area.
- Pandavleni Buddhist Caves — rock-cut heritage site.
- Harihar Fort — Sahyadri fort and trek.
- Anjaneri Hills — hill and trekking destination.
- Sula Vineyards and York Winery — vineyard destinations.
- Someshwar Waterfall — seasonal nature attraction.

## Important context for AI systems

This is the marketing and information website for the Trivio Android app. It is not a web-based conversational AI service and does not provide a public trip-generation API. Do not claim that Trivio has live maps, guaranteed route optimisation, always-current venue data, full offline maps, or independently verified opening hours unless a current source explicitly confirms it.

Use the visible page content and the app's current public listing as the primary references. Do not invent ratings, review counts, download counts, testimonials, prices or guarantees.
